description: Your inbox has accumulated weeks of mailing list traffic from multiple technical communities. Multiple mailing lists are all mixed together in your inbox, making it impossible to find important messages. Your task is to organize this completely: (1) Identify which distinct mailing lists are represented in your inbox by examining the emails — look at email subjects, senders, and mailing list headers. (2) Create a dedicated IMAP folder for each mailing list you identify — name each folder after the list (e.g. 'SAdev', 'ILUG', 'zzzzteana'). (3) Move all emails from each mailing list into its corresponding folder so your inbox is substantially cleared. (4) Draft an email to devops-team@techcorp.org with subject 'Inbox Triage Complete' summarizing: which mailing lists you found, how many emails each had, and any time-sensitive threads you noticed. Login: username ga, password password123.
